about.title: Small team, serious open source
about.text: MovtiGroup is an independent software group building open-source tools for developers worldwide — from AI infrastructure and mirror proxies to bilingual technical content. We believe useful software should be open, fast and accessible to everyone.
about.p1s: Every tool we ship is public by default.

projects.heroSubtitle: Tools and frameworks built with passion — AI infrastructure, mirrors, encoding libraries and developer tooling.
projects.morePrefix: This is a selection — explore the full list on

items.web: This very website — a bilingual (EN/FA) Nuxt 3 site with Nuxt Content v3, full SEO, self-hosted fonts and Docker deployment.
items.liara: Advanced proxy for AI chat-completion models with multi-model support, failover and professional features on Liara Cloud.
items.iranEncoding: Library for the Iran System character encoding — convert legacy Persian text for SMS and embedded systems.
items.dockerInstaller: One-command Docker installation script tuned for servers in Iran, with registry mirrors baked in.
items.dockerMirror: Docker Hub mirror proxy for Iran — pull images without rate limits or connectivity issues.
items.mirror: Documentation and browse mirror for 🇮🇷 — fast access to popular developer resources from inside Iran.
items.mirrorDev: Unified mirror proxy for PyPI, npm, Go modules, NuGet and Maven — speed up package managers for local teams.
items.ubuntuMirror: Smart apt mirror proxy for Ubuntu and Debian with caching and automatic upstream selection.
items.rustVpn: High-performance SSH VPN core written in Rust for fast, secure tunneling.
